basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Forward Deployed Engineer | Customer-Facing Technical Bridge | Python, SQL, Integrations, AI
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer who owns problems end-to-end, from a customer conversation to the code that solves it. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps shipping Python + GCP + Kubernetes systems that 2x outbound conversions; on the side I run Anand Creations, a forward deployed engineering practice built on exactly this: embed with a team, run technical discovery, build the integrations and data flows that make the product usable. Deep across Python, SQL (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse), REST/webhook/OAuth integrations, and modern AI (Claude, GCP Vertex). Comfortable explaining technical work directly to executives and end users.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Own technical delivery of a customer-facing AI product end-to-end: Python multi-agent workflows on GCP Vertex AI, integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo via REST + webhooks, and MCP tool servers exposed to reps. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M/quarter forecast revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ enterprise silos into one queryable, time-aware memory. Data manipulation and integration work that turned scattered CRM/product/conversation data into usable, structured signals.
Report directly to C-level on outcomes. Own eval pipelines (LangSmith), cost telemetry, tool-selection tuning, on-call. Explain technical work to executives without a middle layer.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Built AI Onboarding Specialist: prompt-driven guide that turns new-signup context into personalized, high-touch setup. 100% of customers guided through onboarding without added headcount, cut manual work for Customer Success.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house Python + OpenAI pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated; turned repetitive manual setup into a self-serve automated workflow.
Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams (Elastic Search, ClickHouse). Owned data pipelines, indexing, and ranking with measurable engagement lift for 10M+ users.

Co-owned GTM launches with Sales, PM, and Customer Success (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Ran observability and on-call for global production (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io); reproduced and diagnosed customer issues end-to-end.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised founders on integrations, data workflows, and building customer-facing engineering teams that ship.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for EPFL spin-off drone delivery. Shipped end-to-end platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries. Enterprise-grade integrations enabled Unilever partnership and CES Las Vegas showcase.
Ran technical customer conversations from onboarding through operations. Engineered real-time APIs and logistics workflows: 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety, zero incidents.
